description: Renders the current version in HD (1080×1920, 60 fps). Uses the person's credits like any export: the brief's Make it is the OK in make it for me; in choose each step, Export on the draft card (or their saying export) is the OK to export. Any export after the first MP4 is asked again first. A version shown with "review" is already being rendered on its own: this then just waits for that MP4. Call "video" afterwards for the progress and the MP4 link.
name: export_video
title: Export the MP4
